purpose: Owner-authorized investigation preceding a D12 procedural-reproducibility policy: (i) resolve the D11 instrumentation confound (forward-op variation in D/D3 seen in both D11 arms, never in D10) on the UNCHANGED production graph and device placement; (ii) verify the scientific semantics of the ordinary production path (gradient connectivity, optimizer application, state transitions, counters, finiteness, graph identity) independently of bitwise reproducibility. Diagnostic only: no RunContext, no checkpoint, no run root, no scientific seed, no VAL, no TEST, no source / config / data / RNG / placement / environment change.

prior_evidence_preserved.d10_gate_draft: uncommitted laptop worktree change preserved at local ref refs/drafts/e04-d10-gate-unapproved (09cc14b); not activated, not committed, not used

inputs_fixed.graph: production_runner.prepare() -> unchanged TrainingGraph (construction 61f1ed58..., 11315 ops), original requested devices; no source file is changed
inputs_fixed.data: the qualified Feed over the pinned E04 feed pack (TRAIN only), iteration order from the qualification seed
inputs_fixed.environment: gpat-m6-e03, E04 training precision environment (/tmp/gpat_e04_d10_env.sh, unchanged), PYTHONHASHSEED=60904, production_runner.session_config
inputs_fixed.frozen_identities_sha256: cc77c431600f126af9c0877a0f6590dee816cc1dc09e5c175e40ec0298428291 (production_io.identities as recorded by every D11 process)

stages.authority: tools/e04_d12_authority_check.py on the GPU host (contract, identities, pre-pass, feed pack, environment, prepare, M6D3e reference construction) and --no-tf on the laptop

P_production_path.design: per iteration: D10 localization algorithm over the forward closure (3 plain repeats) at the pre-iteration state; per step: 3 production replays (exactly Controller.iteration's calls) and 2 semantic replays ([apply, gradients, losses] in one call) from the exact restored pre-step state; trajectory continues from production replay 0. No RunOptions in any call.

factors.plain: D10 probe, 1 iteration, no traced call before the localization
factors.d10_trace2: D10 probe plus D11's second FULL_TRACE with output_partition_graphs

C_confound.processes: 4 clean processes per factor, interleaved per process index (plain, d10, d10_trace2, d11_wrapper)
C_confound.localization: unchanged D10 algorithm through a comparing session proxy (same calls); per varying tensor: name, producer, chunk, magnitude

definitions.forward_tensor: a tensor whose producer is in the ancestor closure of the losses and D1-D4 predictions and whose name does not start with 'gradients'
definitions.data_movement_ops: ConcatV2, Identity, Reshape, Slice, StridedSlice, Pack, Unpack, Transpose, GatherNd, Tile, Squeeze, ExpandDims, Placeholder, VariableV2, Split, SplitV, StopGradient
definitions.chunk_local_root: a varying tensor whose producer's inputs were all fetched in the same session call and none of them varied
definitions.functional_variables: trainable variables except the 31 BN-cancelled convolution biases (bias whose layer scope also holds BN/beta; equals the D11 corrected detector set)
definitions.integrity_bound: relative L2 difference ||b - a|| / ||a|| <= 1e-3 (the D10 C4 threshold value); an integrity bound against corruption / wrong computation, not a performance or reproducibility threshold
definitions.adam_tolerance: per element |actual - expected| <= 4 ulp_f32(expected) + 1e-5 |expected - before|, expected = TF 1.15 ApplyAdam (use_nesterov=False) in float64 from the float32 inputs and the gradient fetched in the same call; beta powers exactly float32(before * beta)

criteria.A_authority: contract verified; identities equal the D11-recorded identities; pre-pass 12668 TRAIN rows verified; feed pack verified and bound to the pre-pass; production construction equals 61f1ed58.../11315 and the M6D3e reference construction; every D12 process has those identities and construction, the same initial state (951dad42...), a clean firewall and the protocol sha256
criteria.completion: every process exits 0 with complete records
criteria.B_restore_exact: tool validity: every restore reproduces the recorded state bit-for-bit, and in every stage-C process the comparing proxy finds exactly the varying-tensor count reported by the unchanged D10 algorithm
criteria.B_production_semantics: every process / iteration / step / semantic replay: gradient presence equals differentiable reachability with matching shapes; one ApplyAdam per present step gradient targeting its variable and consuming that gradient; no stateful random op on any step or BN path; each call changes only its allowed variables (BN calls: the moving statistics of that path; apply: the step's variables with gradients, their Adam slots, that optimizer's beta powers, phase, and global_iteration in step 3); Adam within the tolerance; beta powers exact; phase / iteration counters as frozen (1, 2, 0; +1 after step 3); all values finite; diagnostics never mutate state; no op added to the graph
criteria.C1_production_forward_integrity: stage P forward repeats: no fed input varies, no data-movement chunk-local root varies, every varying forward tensor within the integrity bound
criteria.C2_production_gradient_integrity: stage P semantic replays: functional-variable step-gradient difference within the integrity bound for every step
criteria.C3_confound_forward_integrity: stage C (every factor): same as C1 for every varying forward tensor
criteria.D1_confound_reproduced: at least one d11_wrapper process shows forward-tensor variation (otherwise the D11 observation cannot be characterized)
criteria.E_graph_and_placement: the executed device type of every op common to two traced processes is equal across all traced processes and factors; the canonical partition-graph node set and fetched-output canonical hash of every d10_trace2 / d11_wrapper process equal the D11 original-arm values (094566e1... / fea3730e...)

decision_rule.E04_D12_INCONCLUSIVE: A_authority, completion, B_restore_exact or D1_confound_reproduced fails
decision_rule.E04_D12_BLOCKED_BY_SEMANTIC_DEFECT: otherwise, any of B_production_semantics, C1, C2, C3, E fails
decision_rule.NO_SEMANTIC_DEFECT_FOUND: otherwise; the D12 draft (policy and replacement acceptance criteria, written only after this result and before any new qualification evidence) and its regression tests are then prepared, and the reported status is E04_D12_READY_FOR_OWNER_APPROVAL once they are committed; nothing is activated
decision_rule.descriptive_only: which factors show the forward variation, its scope (ops, scopes, magnitudes), production-path step-replay variation (which steps / variables / D3), runtime graph rewrites; never change a criterion
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_change: criteria, bounds, factors, process counts and iterations are fixed by this file and the D12 tools at the commit that adds them

smoke_runs: code-path runs before this file is committed are never interpreted; archived under smoke_not_interpreted/
